query: UPDATE recording_deletion_jobs SET state=CASE WHEN attempts >= $3 THEN 'failed' ELSE 'queued' END,stage=CASE WHEN attempts >= $3 THEN 'failed' ELSE 'retry' END,error=$4,error_kind=$5,retry_at=now()+interval '30 seconds',attempt_token=NULL,lease_expires_at=NULL,updated_at=now(),finished_at=CASE WHEN attempts >= $3 THEN now() ELSE NULL END WHERE id=$1 AND attempt_token=$2 AND state='running'
